# Mont-Saint-Michel Guide

> Independent visitor guide to Mont-Saint-Michel abbey, the bay and the tides. Practical, up-to-date (2026) advice on tickets, getting there, timing and what to see — plus a self-guided offline audio tour by TouringBee. Available in 8 languages: English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Polish and Russian.

This site is a TouringBee project. It is independent and not affiliated with the Abbaye du Mont-Saint-Michel or the local administration. Some links are affiliate links (Tiqets, GetYourGuide, TouringBee); they never affect what is recommended.

## Guides

- [Complete guide to Mont-Saint-Michel](https://montsaintmichelguide.com/): first-time visitor guide — what it is, how a visit works, planning basics.
- [Abbey tickets, prices, hours & what's inside](https://montsaintmichelguide.com/mont-saint-michel-abbey-tickets/): 2026 prices and opening hours, ticket types, best time to go up, and a room-by-room walk through the abbey.
- [How to get to Mont-Saint-Michel](https://montsaintmichelguide.com/how-to-get-to-mont-saint-michel/): by train, car, from Paris and from the airports; parking, the free shuttle and the walk across the causeway.
- [All guides index](https://montsaintmichelguide.com/guides/): full list of guides and articles.

## Audio tour

- [Mont-Saint-Michel self-guided audio tour (TouringBee)](https://touringbee.com/product/mont-saint-michel-audioguide/?wpam_id=40): offline, GPS-based, real-voice narration in 8 languages; explore the island at your own pace.
